T: Sea monster summer. Eat the pasta.
D: Two sea monster boys hide in human form in an Italian seaside town for one summer.
P: Serve the mains when the Portorosso Cup gets to the pasta-eating leg.
S: Zucchini ricotta fritters with parmesan, fried in olive oil
Grated zucchini squeezed dry, mixed with ricotta, egg, parmesan and flour, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with lemon wedges.
dough dimpled with oil, herbs and sea salt, baked golden, for boys saving for a scooter

Focaccia dough proved twice, dimpled with olive oil, rosemary and sea salt, baked at 220C for 20 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 10g salt and 400ml lukewarm water into a wet dough and rest 30 minutes. Stretch and fold it 4 times over the next hour, then pour 60ml olive oil into a 30 x 20cm tin, tip in the dough and leave to rise 1 hour. Dimple all over with oiled fingers, push in rosemary sprigs, drizzle with more oil and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake at 220C for 20 minutes until deep golden.
M: Pesto pasta with potato and green beans
Linguine tossed in basil pesto with potato and green beans
Linguine cooked with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot, drained and tossed with fresh pesto of basil, pine nuts, garlic and parmesan.
Riviera fish, prawn and mussel stew
seafood simmered in tomato, garlic and white wine with fennel until the shells open, crusty bread

Fish, prawns and mussels simmered in a tomato, garlic and white wine broth for 10 minutes until the shells open, with crusty bread. Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add a pinch of chilli, a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and 650ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish in chunks and 8 green prawns, simmer 3 minutes, then add 500g cleaned mussels, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the shells open. Throw away any that stay shut. Finish with parsley and serve with toasted crusty bread.
W: Baked ricotta cake with lemon zest
Ricotta, lemon zest, eggs and sugar beaten smooth, self-raising flour folded in, baked at 170C for 45 minutes and dusted with icing sugar.
Vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet with crushed amaretti and lemon zest
Vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet scooped into small cups side by side, topped with crushed amaretti biscuits and a little lemon zest.
K: Basil sugar syrup mixed with lemon and soda

Fresh lemon juice shaken with a basil sugar syrup, topped with soda water over ice and finished with a strip of lemon peel and basil. Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water until dissolved, take off the heat, add a handful of basil leaves and steep 15 minutes, then strain and chill. Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.

dishes.make_ahead: Scoop the ice cream and sorbet into the cups up to 2 hours ahead and keep in the freezer. Add the amaretti and zest just before serving

steps.text: Scoop the ice cream and sorbet side by side into small cups.
Crush the amaretti over the top.
Finish with a little lemon zest.

dishes.make_ahead: Grate, squeeze and mix the batter up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled. Fry just before serving

steps.text: Grate the zucchini and squeeze dry.
Mix with the ricotta, egg, parmesan and flour.
Fry spoonfuls in olive oil until golden on both sides, in batches.
Serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.n: Pesto pasta with potato and green beans
dishes.make_ahead: Make the pesto up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled under a thin layer of olive oil. Boil the potatoes, linguine and beans on the night

steps.text: Blitz the basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and olive oil into pesto.
Slice the potatoes and trim the beans.
Boil the potatoes in water salted with the salt, then add the linguine and beans to the same pot.
Drain and toss with the pesto.
Beat the ricotta, sugar, eggs and lemon zest until smooth.
Fold in the flour.
Pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 170C until set.
Cool the cake.
Dust with icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Syrup up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the sugar and water until dissolved.
Add the basil, take off the heat and steep, then strain.
Chill the syrup.
Mix the syrup with the lemon juice.
Fill glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with soda water. Twist a strip of peel over each glass and add a small basil sprig.

s.note: Zucchini ricotta fritters with parmesan, fried in olive oil
s.how: Grate 3 zucchini and squeeze dry. Mix with 200g ricotta, an egg, 50g grated parmesan and 80g flour. Fry spoonfuls in olive oil until golden on both sides. Serve with lemon wedges by the harbour.

m.n: Pesto pasta with potato and green beans
m.note: Linguine tossed in basil pesto with potato and green beans
m.how: Blitz 2 bunches basil with 50g pine nuts, a garlic clove, 50g parmesan and olive oil into pesto. Cook 500g linguine with sliced potato and green beans in the same pot. Drain and toss with the pesto. Simple Ligurian food.

w.note: Baked ricotta cake with lemon zest
w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 150g sugar, 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons until smooth. Fold in 150g self-raising flour. Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 45 minutes until set. Cool and dust with icing sugar.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet with crushed amaretti and lemon zest
w.how: Scoop vanilla ice cream and lemon sorbet side by side into small cups. Crush amaretti biscuits over the top and finish with a little lemon zest. Eat them fast on a hot Italian summer afternoon in the town square.

d.note: Basil sugar syrup mixed with lemon and soda

Mix the syrup with the juice of 4 lemons. Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the lemon mix between them and top with 700ml cold soda water. Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass, drop it in and add a small basil sprig.
